description: A 3-day weather delay in Resolute Bay occurred before landing on Devon Island. Cloud ceiling and incoming rain blocked the Twin Otter on three successive days.
response: Crew used the time for local science expeditions, weight triage, crew training, and community outreach. The mission timeline was compressed by 3 days on the island.
lesson: Budget 3-5 extra days in Resolute as a weather buffer. Pre-plan contingency activities for delay days. Do not schedule mission-critical tasks for Days 1-2 on Devon.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.2 Meteorological incidents, lines 581-586. Register Crew tag: 'C16'.
